name: W25 Morning Flow — Bodyweight Spine + Hip (All Days, Rotated Variety)
description:
The daily 15-minute opener. This week rotates roughly half the moves: the W12-era favourites come back — **puppy pose, thread-the-needle, couch stretch, happy baby** — and the work block swaps to spiderman plank + dead bug + wide plié pulses. Anchors stay put: scorpion, lizard, cossack, the push-up greasing set, and the rehab cluster in the day-specific add-on.

**Order is deliberate.** Primer wakes the spine, work block warms the body, and the deep stretch arc goes last because warm muscle stretches further. Don't reorder it to get the stretching over with.

sets.name: Primer — Wake the Spine (~3 min)
sets.notes: Slow and unhurried. You just got out of bed — this is about getting the spine and hips to agree to move, not about a stimulus.

exercises.notes: Back this week after a long absence. Knees under hips, walk the hands forward and let the chest sink — then flow into cat-cow from there. **Thoracic extension is the target**, so let the low back stay quiet and the mid-back do the moving.
45s each side. **Rotate from the mid-back, not the neck.** The bottom shoulder reaches through and the ribcage follows — chase the rotation, not the depth.
Tight fists, thumbs tucked, hinged slightly forward. Wakes the deep core before anything loaded.

sets.name: Work Block — Bodyweight Activation (~5 min)
sets.notes: Warm the body. **Activate, don't fatigue** — this precedes a gym session most days.

exercises.notes: The greasing set. **Never to failure** — leave 2-3 in the tank, every single day. Elbows ~45°, shoulders packed DOWN not shrugged up.
**Ribs down, low back flat to the floor** — that contact is the whole exercise. Slow, opposite arm and leg, no rush.
Plank, drive the knee to the outside of the same elbow. Hips stay level — no piking, no sagging.
Wide stance, toes out, sink to depth and pulse. **Knees track the toes.** The Action Jacqueline beat — light, high-rep, wakes the adductors and glutes without loading anything.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Deep Stretch Arc (~7 min)
sets.notes: One continuous arc — flow between shapes rather than stopping and setting up each one. Body is warm now, so these go deeper than they would cold.

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Prone, reach the foot across to the opposite hand. Front-of-hip and chest open together.
45s each side. Deep hip opener. Drop to the forearms if the hip allows — **and it does more often than it used to.**
**Depth is the project and it's working** — the down heel is flat now where it used to be on the ball of the foot. Sit into one hip, other leg straight, heel down, get lower than comfortable.

45s each side. Back this week after a long absence. Rear foot up on a wall or couch, **squeeze the glute of the back leg** and tuck the pelvis — that's what turns it from a knee stretch into a hip flexor stretch.
Back this week. Grab the outsides of the feet, knees toward the armpits, and let the low back release into the floor. The parasympathetic downshift to finish on.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)
sets.notes:
Not all of these every day — pick the cluster that matches what you're about to train.

**Push day:** doorframe chest stretch · prone Y-raise · scapular push-up
**Pull day:** dead hang · scapular pull · side-lying external rotation
**KB days:** wall angel · side-lying ER · dead hang
**Legs day:** standing cross-leg lateral · pigeon · supine twist

exercises.notes: 45s each arm at MID elbow height. Push day opener.
Rehab anchor. Thumbs up, lift from the mid-back, **no shrug.**
Rehab anchor. Arms locked, move only the shoulder blades — protract and retract.
Rehab anchor, and the direct one for the right shoulder. Elbow pinned to the ribs, rotate from the shoulder.
Rehab anchor. Low back and forearms stay on the wall the whole way — **if the back arches, you've gone too high.**
Rehab anchor. Passive hang, shoulders relaxed up around the ears. Decompression.
Rehab anchor. From the hang, pull the shoulder blades DOWN without bending the elbows.
30s each side. QL release — legs day opener.
45s each side. Legs day.
30s each side. Legs day, or any day the low back is talking.

tips: **Work before stretches, always.** Warm muscle stretches deeper — that's why the yoga arc is last.
**The push-up set is a greasing set, not a workout.** Leave 2-3 reps in the tank every day.
**Short beats skipped.** Ten minutes counts. Five counts.
